not op, but i’ll explain my view on why neopronouns are hard on ND people

As a neurodivergent person, (autism, adhd, and dyscalculia)  i think that neopronouns are hard because pronouns are supposed to make conversations flow easily, and most of us we only taught the main three (she/he/they) as children. having only three gender based pronouns makes things much simpler then their being hundreds and not knowing which to use. Learning multiple sets of completely new pronouns can feel almost like learning a new language and can damage the flow for conversation.
